006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.impl.AbstractFunction;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.ISequenceType;
014
015import java.util.Collections;
016import java.util.EnumSet;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.Set;
019
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
022
023/**
024 * Provides a concrete implementation of a function call executor.
025 */
026public class DefaultFunction
027    extends AbstractFunction {
028  // private static final Logger logger =
029  // LogManager.getLogger(AbstractFunction.class);
030
031  @NonNull
032  private final Set<FunctionProperty> properties;
033  @NonNull
034  private final ISequenceType result;
035  @NonNull
036  private final IFunctionExecutor handler;
037
038  /**
039   * Construct a new function signature.
040   *
041   * @param name
042   *          the name of the function
043   * @param properties
044   *          the characteristics of the function
045   * @param arguments
046   *          the argument signatures or an empty list
047   * @param result
048   *          the type of the result
049   * @param handler
050   *          the handler to call to execute the function
051   */
052  @SuppressWarnings({ "null", "PMD.LooseCoupling" })
053  DefaultFunction(
054      @NonNull String name,
055      @NonNull String namespace,
056      @NonNull EnumSet<FunctionProperty> properties,
057      @NonNull List<IArgument> arguments,
058      @NonNull ISequenceType result,
059      @NonNull IFunctionExecutor handler) {
060    super(name, namespace, arguments);
061    this.properties = Collections.unmodifiableSet(properties);
062    this.result = result;
063    this.handler = handler;
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public Set<FunctionProperty> getProperties() {
068    return properties;
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  public ISequenceType getResult() {
073    return result;
074  }
075
076  @Override
077  public boolean isNamedFunction() {
078    return true;
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Execute the provided function using the provided arguments, dynamic context,
083   * and focus.
084   *
085   * @param arguments
086   *          the function arguments
087   * @param dynamicContext
088   *          the dynamic evaluation context
089   * @param focus
090   *          the current focus item in the evaluation context. This represents
091   *          the context item for anonymous function evaluation. May be null for
092   *          functions that don't require context item access.
093   * @return a sequence containing the result of the execution
094   * @throws MetapathException
095   *           if an error occurred while executing the function
096   */
097  @Override
098  @NonNull
099  protected ISequence<?> executeInternal(
100      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
101      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
102      @Nullable IItem focus) {
103    return handler.execute(this, arguments, dynamicContext, focus);
104  }
105}
